WITH event_rates AS (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, AVG(1.0 * b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_spending_rate
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
), type_rates AS (
    SELECT e.type, AVG(er.avg_spending_rate) AS avg_spending_rate
    FROM event_rates AS er
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = er.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type, avg_spending_rate,
       avg_spending_rate / NULLIF(AVG(avg_spending_rate) OVER (), 0) AS rate_divided_by_mean
FROM type_rates;

assumptions.assumption: A zero budget amount makes that line’s spending rate undefined, so it is excluded from the event average, consistent with ignoring missing values; events with no defined line rates are excluded from the type average.
